title.de: Mein, dein, Jacks: my, your, Jack's

goal.sl: Poveš, čigavo je kaj: my, your, his, her, its, our, their pred stvarjo, brez the, in Jack's dog, the boys' bikes; his in her izbereš po lastniku, ne po stvari.
goal.de: Du sagst, wem etwas gehört: my, your, his, her, its, our, their vor dem Ding, ohne the, und Jack's dog, the boys' bikes; his und her nach dem Besitzer, nicht nach dem Ding.
goal.it: Dici di chi è una cosa: my, your, his, her, its, our, their davanti alla cosa, senza the, e Jack's dog, the boys' bikes; his e her secondo il proprietario, non la cosa.
goal.en: You can say whose something is: my, your, his, her, its, our, their before the thing, with no the, and Jack's dog, the boys' bikes; his and her by the owner, not by the thing.

say.sl: **my** (moj) in **your** (tvoj, vaš) stojita pred stvarjo: **my bike** (moje kolo), **your cup** (tvoja skodelica). **your** je za vsakogar, za enega ali več: **your coat, Mrs Hartley** (vaš plašč, gospa Hartley), **your coats, children** (vaši plašči, otroci). Za stvar se nikoli ne spremenita: **my bike**, **my bikes** (moja kolesa), **my brother** (moj brat), **my sister** (moja sestra).
say.de: **my** (mein) und **your** (dein, Ihr, euer) stehen vor dem Ding: **my bike** (mein Fahrrad), **your cup** (deine Tasse). **your** ist für alle, für eine Person oder mehrere: **your coat, Mrs Hartley** (Ihr Mantel, Mrs Hartley), **your coats, children** (eure Mäntel, Kinder). Für das Ding ändern sie sich nie: **my bike**, **my bikes** (meine Fahrräder), **my brother** (mein Bruder), **my sister** (meine Schwester).
say.it: **my** (mio) e **your** (tuo, Suo, vostro) vanno prima della cosa: **my bike** (la mia bici), **your cup** (la tua tazza). **your** è per tutti, per una persona o più: **your coat, Mrs Hartley** (il Suo cappotto, Mrs Hartley), **your coats, children** (i vostri cappotti, bambini). Per la cosa non cambiano mai: **my bike**, **my bikes** (le mie bici), **my brother** (mio fratello), **my sister** (mia sorella).
say.en: **my** and **your** go before the thing: **my bike**, **your cup**. **your** is for everyone, one person or more: **your coat, Mrs Hartley**, **your coats, children**. They never change for the thing: **my bike**, **my bikes**, **my brother**, **my sister**.

examples.sl: Tukaj je vaš plašč, gospa Hartley.
examples.de: Hier ist Ihr Mantel, Mrs Hartley.
examples.it: Ecco il Suo cappotto, Mrs Hartley.

say.sl: Za eno drugo osebo ali stvar odloča lastnik: **his** (njegov) za moškega ali fanta, **her** (njen) za žensko ali dekle, **its** (njegov, njen) za stvar ali žival: **Jack and his dog** (Jack in njegov pes), **Mrs Birkett and her inn** (gospa Birkett in njena gostilna), **the mill and its wheel** (mlin in njegovo kolo). Stvar ni pomembna: **his sister** (njegova sestra), **her brother** (njen brat).
say.de: Bei einer anderen Person oder Sache entscheidet der Besitzer: **his** (sein) für einen Mann oder Jungen, **her** (ihr) für eine Frau oder ein Mädchen, **its** (sein, ihr) für eine Sache oder ein Tier: **Jack and his dog** (Jack und sein Hund), **Mrs Birkett and her inn** (Mrs Birkett und ihr Gasthaus), **the mill and its wheel** (die Mühle und ihr Rad). Wie im Deutschen zählt das Ding nicht: **his sister** (seine Schwester), **her brother** (ihr Bruder).
say.it: Per un'altra persona o cosa decide il proprietario, non la cosa: **his** (suo, di lui) per un uomo o un ragazzo, **her** (suo, di lei) per una donna o una ragazza, **its** per una cosa o un animale: **Jack and his dog** (Jack e il suo cane), **Mrs Birkett and her inn** (Mrs Birkett e la sua locanda), **the mill and its wheel** (il mulino e la sua ruota). Così **his sister** (sua sorella, di lui), **her brother** (suo fratello, di lei).
say.en: For one other person or thing, the owner decides: **his** for a man or a boy, **her** for a woman or a girl, **its** for a thing or an animal: **Jack and his dog**, **Mrs Birkett and her inn**, **the mill and its wheel**. The thing doesn't matter: **his sister**, **her brother**.

say.sl: Za več lastnikov: **our** (naš, za we) in **their** (njihov, za they): **our village** (naša vas), **their farm** (njihova kmetija). Z **my**, **your**, **his**, **her**, **its**, **our** in **their** nikoli **the** ali **a**: **my dog**, ne *the my dog*. **their** in **there** se slišita enako: **their farm** (njihova kmetija), a **over there** (tam).
say.de: Für mehrere Besitzer: **our** (unser, für we) und **their** (ihr, für they): **our village** (unser Dorf), **their farm** (ihr Hof). Nie **the** oder **a** mit **my**, **your**, **his**, **her**, **its**, **our** und **their**: **my dog**, nicht *the my dog*. **their** und **there** klingen gleich: **their farm** (ihr Hof), aber **over there** (dort drüben).
say.it: Per più proprietari: **our** (nostro, per we) e **their** (loro, per they): **our village** (il nostro paese), **their farm** (la loro fattoria). Mai **the** o **a** con **my**, **your**, **his**, **her**, **its**, **our** e **their**, anche se l'italiano ha l'articolo: **my dog** (il mio cane), non *the my dog*. **their** e **there** suonano uguali: **their farm** (la loro fattoria), ma **over there** (laggiù).
say.en: For more owners: **our** (we) and **their** (they): **our village**, **their farm**. Never **the** or **a** with **my**, **your**, **his**, **her**, **its**, **our** or **their**: **my dog**, not *the my dog*. **their** and **there** sound the same: **their farm**, but **over there**.

examples.it: Il nostro paese è vicino al lago.

say.sl: Pri imenu ali osebi dodaš lastniku **'s**, nato pride stvar: **Jack's dog** (Jackov pes), **Mrs Birkett's inn** (gostilna gospe Birkett), **Granny Maggie's kitchen** (kuhinja babice Maggie). Lastnik je spredaj, brez **of** in brez **the**. Opuščaj se piše: **Jack's**, ne *Jacks*. Tu **'s** ni **is**: **Jack's dog** je Jackov pes.
say.de: Bei einem Namen oder einer Person kommt **'s** an den Besitzer, dann das Ding: **Jack's dog** (Jacks Hund), **Mrs Birkett's inn** (Mrs Birketts Gasthaus), **Granny Maggie's kitchen** (Oma Maggies Küche). Anders als im Deutschen mit Apostroph: **Jack's**, nicht *Jacks*. Hier ist **'s** nicht **is**: **Jack's dog** ist Jacks Hund.
say.it: Con un nome o una persona aggiungi **'s** al proprietario, poi viene la cosa: **Jack's dog** (il cane di Jack), **Mrs Birkett's inn** (la locanda di Mrs Birkett), **Granny Maggie's kitchen** (la cucina di nonna Maggie). Al contrario dell'italiano, prima il proprietario, senza **of** e senza **the**. Con l'apostrofo: **Jack's**, non *Jacks*. Qui **'s** non è **is**: **Jack's dog** è il cane di Jack.
say.en: For a name or a person, add **'s** to the owner, then the thing: **Jack's dog**, **Mrs Birkett's inn**, **Granny Maggie's kitchen**. The owner comes first, with no **of** and no **the**. Write the apostrophe: **Jack's**, not *Jacks*. Here **'s** isn't **is**: **Jack's dog** is the dog of Jack.

say.sl: Več lastnikov na **-s** dobi samo opuščaj: **the boys' bikes** (kolesa fantov, več fantov). Množina brez **-s** dobi **'s**: **the children's books** (knjige otrok), **the men's boots** (čevlji moških). **its** pa je brez opuščaja: **its roof** (njegova streha); **it's** je **it is**: **It's cold.** (Mrzlo je.)
say.de: Mehrere Besitzer auf **-s** bekommen nur den Apostroph: **the boys' bikes** (die Fahrräder der Jungen). Ein Plural ohne **-s** bekommt **'s**: **the children's books** (die Bücher der Kinder), **the men's boots** (die Stiefel der Männer). Und **its** hat keinen Apostroph: **its roof** (sein Dach); **it's** ist **it is**: **It's cold.** (Es ist kalt.)
say.it: Più proprietari in **-s** prendono solo l'apostrofo: **the boys' bikes** (le bici dei ragazzi). Un plurale senza **-s** prende **'s**: **the children's books** (i libri dei bambini), **the men's boots** (gli scarponi degli uomini). E **its** è senza apostrofo: **its roof** (il suo tetto); **it's** è **it is**: **It's cold.** (Fa freddo.)
say.en: More owners in **-s** take only the apostrophe: **the boys' bikes** (more than one boy). A plural without **-s** takes **'s**: **the children's books**, **the men's boots**. And **its** has no apostrophe: **its roof**; **it's** is **it is**: **It's cold.**
